description:
Hushfeed v0.56.0 targets global TikTok 47.0.3 (com.zhiliaoapp.musically).

Feed screen adds Hide the search bar below videos. It removes the suggested-search strip above the bottom tabs and gives that space back to video details and side controls. Top search and comment suggestions keep their own settings.

This release also includes separate switches to hide the Full screen button and location labels. Feed filter, under Ads, adds Filter location-tagged videos. Hiding the badge and filtering the video are independent choices. A location badge doesn't prove a video is a paid ad. Comment tools adds Easier comment likes, which extends the heart's touch area into nearby empty space without enlarging comment rows. These options are off by default and need a restart.

Validation: 1562 runtime tests passed locally, plus 265 patch tests. Both Android lint checks passed. The bundle carries 91 patches and all three nonempty DEX payloads. All 91 patches applied to TikTok 47.0.3 and retained 46.2.3, 46.7.3, 46.8.3 and 46.9.3 fixtures with no manifest changes. Older fixtures are compatibility checks. Use 47.0.3 when patching.

The exact release-derived APK was installed on the S22 with the same signing key and unchanged first-install time. On the same public video, the search strip's 101-pixel reservation disappeared completely. Video details and side controls used that space while the bottom tabs and seek bar stayed fixed. The repositioned comment button and Back worked. Earlier S22 checks cover the independent location options and comment-heart touch area. The S25 wasn't updated because its signing key differs from the local test key.

The Morphe source repair remains included. If you saw The remote metadata file is unavailable, refresh the Hushfeed source. You don't need to clear Manager data or change its signing key.

Needs Morphe Manager 1.30.0 or newer. The downloadable .mpp is a patch bundle, not a TikTok APK. Keep the manager's existing signing key when updating.
